I couldn't find a name for that person. The Coastal cheat sheet says engineering gave Driftmoor Marine Freight's night dispatcher a manual CSV patch after the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. It doesn't say who the dispatcher is or give an email address. Nothing else I can read mentions a Driftmoor night-dispatch contact.

The quickest way to get the name is to ask Kwame, since it's his account. Once you have it, send me the address. Mail to anyone outside pemberline.com, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval, and I'll request that before drafting the patch note.
